lines.arabic: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لَيْسَ لِقَضَائِهِ دَافِعٌ
lines.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi laysa liqada'ihi dafi`un
lines.english: Praise be to Allah Whose determination cannot be repelled by anything,
Whose gifts cannot be stopped by anything,
and Whose making cannot be resembled by the making of anyone.
He is the All-magnanimous, the All-liberal.
He originated the genus of the wonderfully created things
and He perfected the made things by His wisdom.
All growing things cannot be hidden from Him
and all things deposited with Him shall never be wasted.
He is the Repayer on every deed,
the Enricher of every satisfied one,
the Merciful toward every suppliant,
and the Revealer of the benefits
and the All-comprehensive Book with the glaring light.
He is also the Hearer of prayers,
the Warder-off of anguishes,
the Raiser of ranks,
and the Suppressor of the tyrants.
There is no god other than Him
and there is nothing equivalent to Him
and nothing like a likeness of Him,
and He is the All-hearing, the All-seeing,
the All-gentle, the All-aware,
and He has power over all things.
O Allah, I willingly desire for You
and I testify to the Lordship of You,
confessing that You are verily my Lord
and to You shall be my return.
You had begun bestowing on me
before I was anything worth mentioning,
and You created me from dust.
You then put me up in the loins,
(making me) saved from vicissitudes of time,
and change of ages and years.

lines.arabic: فَلَمْ أَزَلْ ظَاعِناً مِنْ صُلْبٍ إِلَىٰ رَحِمٍ
lines.transliteration: falam azal za`inan min sulbin ila rahimin
lines.english: I was moving from a loin to a womb
throughout the passage of the past days
and the ancient ages;
as You have not taken me out (to this world)—on account of Your sympathy to me,
Your kindness to me,
and Your compassion to me—
in the government of the heads of unbelief
who breached their covenant with You
and denied Your messengers.

lines.arabic: لٰكِنَّكَ أَخْرَجْتَنِي لِلَّذِي سَبَقَ لِي مِنَ ٱلْهُدَىٰ
lines.transliteration: lakinnaka akhrajtani lilladhi sabaqa li min alhuda
lines.english: However, You took me out on account of the guidance that You have already known about me
and You have made easy the way to it
and You have brought me up in it.

lines.transliteration: wa min qabli dhalika ra'ufta bi
lines.english: Even before that, You had compassion on me,
through Your excellent conferral
and Your affluent bestowals.
So, You fashioned my creation from semen that gushed forth
and put me up in triple darkness

lines.transliteration: bayna lahmin wa damin wa jildin
lines.english: among flesh, blood, and skin.
You have not made me witness my creation,

lines.arabic: وَلَمْ تَجْعَلْ إِلَيَّ شَيْئاً مِنْ أَمْرِي
lines.transliteration: wa lam taj`al ilayya shay'an min amri
lines.english: and You have not referred any part of my creation to me.

lines.arabic: ثُمَّ أَخْرَجْتَنِي لِلَّذِي سَبَقَ لِي مِنَ ٱلْهُدَىٰ
lines.transliteration: thumma akhrajtani lilladhi sabaqa li min alhuda
lines.english: You then took me out on account of the guidance that You have already known about me
to the world, perfect and in sound health.

lines.transliteration: wa hafiztani fi almahdi tiflan sabiyyan
lines.english: You have safeguarded me in the cradle as small child.

lines.transliteration: wa razaqtani min alghidha'i labanan mariyyan
lines.english: You have provided me with wholesome milk as food.
You have made the hearts of the nursemaids tender.
You have given me into the charge of merciful mothers.
You have saved me from the visits of the Jinn.
You have delivered me from increase and decrease.
So, Exalted be You, O All-merciful, O All-beneficent.
When I commenced (my life) by pronouncing words,
You perfected for me the affluent bestowals,
and brought me up with an increase every year.
When my creation was accomplished,
and my power became straight,
You put me under the obligation of Your Claim,
which is that You inspired me with recognition of You
and alarmed me by the wonders of Your wisdom,

lines.arabic: وَأَيْقَظْتَنِي لِمَا ذَرَأْتَ فِي سَمَائِكَ وَأَرْضِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa ayqaztani lima dhara'ta fi sama'ika wa ardika
lines.english: and You aroused in me that which You created in Your heavens and lands,
which is the excellent creation of You.
You attracted my attentions to thank and mention You.
You made obligatory on me to obey and worship You.

lines.transliteration: wa fahhamtani ma ja'at bihi rusuluka
lines.english: You made me understand that with which Your Apostles came.
You made easy for me to find agreeable Your pleasure.
You bestowed upon me with the favor of all that,
out of Your aid and Your gentleness.

lines.arabic: ثُمَّ إِذْ خَلَقْتَنِي مِنْ خَيْرِ ٱلثَّرَىٰ
lines.transliteration: thumma idh khalaqtani min khayri alththara
lines.english: As You created me from the best of soil,

lines.arabic: لَمْ تَرْضَ لِي يَا إِلٰهِي نِعْمَةً دُونَ أُخْرَىٰ
lines.transliteration: lam tarda li ya ilahi ni`matan duna ukhra
lines.english: You, my God, have not wanted for me to have a certain favor (and to be deprived of another)
and You therefore provided me with the various kinds of living
and types of wealth,
out of Your great and grand conferral upon me,
and Your eternal kindness to me.

lines.arabic: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا أَتْمَمْتَ عَلَيَّ جَمِيعَ ٱلنِّعَمِ
lines.english: As You perfected for me all the graces
and warded off all misfortunes,
my ignorance of You and challenge have not stopped You

lines.arabic: أَنْ دَلَلْتَنِي إِلَىٰ مَا يُقَرِّبُنِي إِلَيْكَ
lines.transliteration: an dalaltani ila ma yuqarribuni ilayka
lines.english: from showing me that which takes me near to You,
and from leading me to that which grants me proximity to You.
So, if I pray You, You will respond to me;
and if I beg You, You will give me;
and if I obey You, You will thank me;
and if I thank You, You will give me more.
All that is completion of Your favors for me,
and Your kindness to me.
So, all glory be to You; all glory be to You.
You are verily Originator and Reproducer (of the creation)
and worthy of all praise and full of all glory.
Holy be Your Names
as Your bounties are so immeasurable.

lines.arabic: فَأَيَّ نِعَمِكَ يَا إِلٰهِي أُحْصِي عَدَداً وَذِكْراً؟
lines.transliteration: fa'ayya ni`amika ya ilahi uhsi `adadan wa dhikran
lines.english: Which of Your favors, O my God, can I count in numbers and examples?

lines.arabic: أَمْ أَيَّ عَطَايَاكَ أَقُومُ بِهَا شُكْراً
lines.english: Or which of Your gifts can I thank properly?

lines.arabic: وَهِيَ يَا رَبِّ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ أَنْ يُحْصِيهَا ٱلْعَادُّونَ
lines.transliteration: wa hiya ya rabbi aktharu min an yuhsiha al`adduna
lines.english: They are, O my Lord, too numerous to be counted by counters
or to be realized by memorizers.
Moreover, that which You have warded off and repelled,
O Allah, from (the various kinds of) harm and mischief

lines.arabic: أَكْثَرُ مِمَّا ظَهَرَ لِي مِنَ ٱلْعَافِيَةِ وَٱلسَّرَّاءِ
lines.transliteration: aktharu mimma zahara li min al`afiyati walssarra'i
lines.english: is more than that which came to me from wellbeing and joy.

lines.arabic: وَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ يَا إِلٰهِي بِحَقِيقَةِ إِيـمَانِي
lines.transliteration: wa ana ashhadu ya ilahi bihaqiqati imani
lines.english: And I bear witness, O my God, with my true belief,
and the fortitude of the determinations of my conviction
and the purity of my open belief in Your Oneness
and the essence of the secret of my conscience,
and the ties of the canals of the light of my sight,
and the lines of my forehead
and the hallows of the courses of my breath,
and the (nasal) cavities of my nose,
and the courses of the meatus of my hearing,

lines.transliteration: wa ma dammat wa atbaqat `alayhi shafataya
lines.english: and whatever my two lips hide and cover up,
and the motions of the vocalization of my tongue,

lines.transliteration: wa maghrazi hanaki fami wa fakki
lines.english: and the socket of the palate of my mouth and jaw,
and the matrices of my dents,
and the tasting of my food and my drink,
and the carrier of my skill,
and the tube of the tissues of my neck
and what is included by the cloak of my chest,
and the carriers of the cord of my aorta,
and the cords of the pericardium of my heart,
and the pieces of the retinues of my liver,
and that which is included by the cartilages of my ribs,
and the cavities of my joints,
and the interactings of my organisms,
and the extremes of my fingertips,
and my flesh, and my blood,
and my hair, and my skin,
and my nerve, and my sinews,
and my bones, and my brain, and my veins,
and all of my organs,

lines.arabic: وَمَا ٱنْتَسَجَ عَلَىٰ ذٰلِكَ أَيَّامَ رِضَاعِي
lines.transliteration: wa ma intasaja `ala dhalika ayyama rida`i
lines.english: and that which was pieced together during the days of my suckling,
and whatever of my body that the ground carries,

lines.transliteration: wa nawmi wa yaqzati wa sukuni
lines.english: and my sleeping, and my wakefulness, and my motionlessness,
and the movements of my bowing and prostration;

lines.arabic: أَنْ لَوْ حَاوَلْتُ وَٱجْتَهَدْتُ مَدَىٰ ٱلأَعْصَارِ
lines.transliteration: an law hawaltu wa ijtahadtu mada al-a`sari
lines.english: (by all that I bear witness) that if I try my best and strive throughout all ages
and all times, if I live them,

lines.arabic: أَنْ أُؤَدِّيَ شُكْرَ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْ أَنْعُمِكَ
lines.transliteration: an u'addiya shukra wahidatin min an`umika
lines.english: to thank properly only one of Your favors,
I will not be able to do that,

lines.arabic: إِلاَّ بِمَنِّكَ ٱلْمُوجَبِ عَلَيَّ بِهِ شُكْرُكَ
lines.english: except through a favor of You, which also requires me to thank You for it,
once again with new thanking
and with praise that is newly acquired and newly prepared.
True is this! And if I try hard,
as well as the counters from Your creatures,
to count the scope of Your favoring,
both the past and the present,
we shall never be able to calculate it in number,
or count it in time.
Too far is this! How can it be!

lines.transliteration: wa anta almukhbiru fi kitabika alnnatiqi
lines.english: While it is You Who have informed in Your rational Book
and true news:

lines.transliteration: wa'in ta`uddu ni`mata allahi la tuhsuha
lines.english: “And if you count Allah's favors, you will not be able to number them.”
True is Your Book, O Allah, and Your informing.
Your Prophets and Messengers have conveyed
what You revealed to them, from Your Revelation,

lines.transliteration: wa shara`ta lahum wa bihim min dinika
lines.english: and what You have made plain for them and through them Your religion.
Nevertheless, O my God,
I bear witness by my ultimate possibility and my diligence
and the scope of my vigor and my capacity,
and I say with full faith and conviction:

lines.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَداً
lines.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi lam yattakhidh waladan
lines.english: All praise be to Allah Who has not taken to Himself a son
to be inherited,

lines.arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيكٌ فِي مُلْكِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa lam yakun lahu sharikun fi mulkihi
lines.english: and Who does not have a partner in His kingdom,
to oppose Him in what He fashions,
and Who does not have a helper to save Him from disgrace,
to help Him in what He makes.
So, glory be to Him, glory be to Him.

lines.arabic: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَا آلِهَةٌ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا وَتَفَطَّرَتَا
lines.transliteration: law kana fihima alihatun illa allahu lafasadata wa tafattarata
lines.english: If there had been in them any gods except Allah, they would both have certainly been in a state of disorder and destruction.
All glory be to Allah, the One, the Only One, the Besought of all,

lines.transliteration: alladhi lam yalid wa lam yulad
lines.english: Who begets not nor is He begotten,

lines.transliteration: wa lam yakun lahu kufwan ahadun
lines.english: and there is none like Him.

lines.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْداً يُعَادِلُ حَمْدَ مَلائِكَتِهِ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
lines.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi hamdan yu`adilu hamda mala'ikatihi almuqarrabina
lines.english: All praise be to Allah—praise that is equal to the praise of His Favorite Angels,
and His missioned Prophets.
May Allah send blessings to His Select,
Muhammad, the Seal of Prophets,

lines.transliteration: wa alihi alttayyibina alttahirina almukhlasina wa sallama
lines.english: and upon his Household, the pure, immaculate, and well-chosen, and may He send benedictions upon them.
O Allah, (please) make me fear You as if I can see You.
Make happy by fearing You.
Do not make me unhappy by disobeying You.
Choose for me through Your decree.
Bless me through Your determination,

lines.arabic: حَتَّىٰ لا أُحِبَّ تَعْجِيلَ مَا أَخَّرْتَ
lines.transliteration: hatta la uhibba ta`jila ma akhkharta
lines.english: so that I will not long for hastening that which You have delayed
or delaying that which You would hasten.
O Allah, (please) make my richness in my conscience,
conviction in my hear,
sincerity in my deeds,
light in my sight,
and insight in my religion.
Make me find enjoyment in my organs.

lines.transliteration: waj`al sam`i wa basari alwarithayni minni
lines.english: Make my hearing and my sight sound until I am inherited.
Grant me victory over him who wrongs me,

lines.transliteration: wa arini fihi tha'ri wa ma'aribi
lines.english: make me witness my avenge and objective in him,
and make it the delight of my eye.
O Allah, (please) relieve my agony,
conceal my flaws,
forgive my sin,
drive away my devil from me,
redeem my mortgage,

lines.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْ لِي يَا إِلٰهِي ٱلدَّرَجَةَ ٱلْعُلْيَا
lines.transliteration: waj`al li ya ilahi alddarajata al`ulya
lines.english: and decide for me, O my God, the supreme rank
in the Hereafter and in the former (life).
O Allah, all praise be to You for You have created me
and made me hear and see.
All praise be to You for you have created me
and made my creation perfect, on account of Your having mercy on me,
and You could dispense with creating me.
O my Lord, as You gave rise to me and perfected my creation;
O my Lord, as You originated me and did well my form;

lines.arabic: رَبِّ بِمَا أَحْسَنْتَ إِلَيَّ وَفِي نَفْسِي عَافَيْتَنِي
lines.transliteration: rabbi bima ahsanta ilayya wa fi nafsi `afaytani
lines.english: O my Lord, as You conferred favors on me and granted me wellbeing in my self;
O my Lord, as You saved me and led me to success;
O my Lord, as You bestowed favors on me and guided me;

lines.arabic: رَبِّ بِمَا أَوْلَيْتَنِي وَمِنْ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ أَعْطَيْتَنِي
lines.transliteration: rabbi bima awlaytani wa min kulli khayrin a`taytani
lines.english: O my Lord, as You presented me and gave me from every good;
O my Lord, as you fed me and watered me;
O my Lord, as You enriched me and gave me to hold;
O my Lord, as You helped me and braced me;

lines.arabic: رَبِّ بِمَا أَلْبَسْتَنِي مِنْ سِتْرِكَ ٱلصَّافِي
lines.transliteration: rabbi bima albastani min sitrika alssafi
lines.english: O my Lord, as you clothed me from Your pure cover

lines.transliteration: wa yassarta li min sun`ika alkafi
lines.english: and made easy for me Your adequate making,
so, (please) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
help me against calamities of ages
and changes of nights and days,
rescue me from the horrors of this world
and the anguishes of the Hereafter,

lines.arabic: وَٱكْفِنِي شَرَّ مَا يَعْمَلُ ٱلظَّالِمُونَ فِي ٱلأَرْضِ
lines.transliteration: wakfini sharra ma ya`malu alzzalimuna fi al-ardi
lines.english: and save me from the evils of what the wrongdoers do in the earth.
O Allah, as to what I anticipate, (please) save me (from it).
As to what I watch out, (please) protect me (against it).

lines.transliteration: wa fi nafsi wa dini fahrusni
lines.english: Safeguard me in my soul and religion,
watch over me in my journeys,

lines.transliteration: wa fi ahli wa mali fakhlufni
lines.english: be in charge of my family members and properties during my absence,
bless me in that which You provide as sustenance,
make me see myself as humble,
make people see me as great,

lines.transliteration: wa min sharri aljinni wal-insi fasallimni
lines.english: keep me sound from the evils of the Jinn and people,
do not disclose me because of my sins,
do not disgrace me because of the secret side (of myself),
do not try me in my deeds,
do not deprive me of Your bounties,
and do not refer me to anyone other than You.
To whom do You entrust me?
To a relative, and he will rupture my relation with him!
Or to a strange, and he will glower at me!
Or to those who deem me weak!

lines.transliteration: wa anta rabbi wa maliku amri
lines.english: While You are my Lord and the master of my affairs!

lines.transliteration: ashku ilayka ghurbati wa bu`da dari
lines.english: I complain to You about my alienation and my foreignness
and my ignominy in the eyes of him whom You have given domination over me.
So, O my God, do not make Your wrath come upon me.

lines.arabic: فَإِنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ غَضِبْتَ عَلَيَّ فَلاَ أُبَالِي سِوَاكَ
lines.transliteration: fa'in lam takun ghadibta `alayya fala ubali siwaka
lines.english: If You are not wrathful with me, then I care for nothing save You.

lines.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ غَيْرَ أَنَّ عَافِيَتَكَ أَوْسَعُ لِي
lines.english: All glory be to You; yet, Your granting me wellbeing is more favorable for me.
So, I beseech You, O my Lord, in the name of the Light of Your Face
to which the earth and the heavens have shone,
by which all darkness has been uncovered,

lines.transliteration: wa saluha bihi amru al-awwalina wal-akhirina
lines.english: and by which the affairs of the past and the coming generations are made right,
(please) do not cause me to die while You are wrathful with me
and do not inflict on me Your rage.
You have the right to scold; You have the right to scold;
until You are pleased (with me) before that.
There is no god save You;
Lord of the Holy City,
the Holy Monument,
and the Ancient House
that You have encompassed with blessing
and made security for people.

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ عَفَا عَنْ عَظِيمِ ٱلذُّنُوبِ بِحِلْمِهِ
lines.english: O He Who pardoned the grand sins by His forbearance!
O He Who bestowed bounties by His favoring!
O He Who gave in abundance by His generosity!
O my means in my hardship!
O my companion in my loneliness!
O my relief in my agony!
O my Benefactor in my amenities!
O my God and the God of my forefathers:
Abraham, Ishmael,
Isaac, and Jacob;

lines.transliteration: wa rabba jabra'ila wa mika'ila wa israfila
lines.english: the Lord of Gabriel, Michael, and Seraph;
the Lord of Muhammad, the Seal of Prophets,
and his elite Household;
the Revealer of the Torah, the Gospel,
the Psalms, and the Furqan;

lines.transliteration: wa munazzila kaf-ha-ya-`ain-sad wa ta-ha wa ya-sin
lines.english: the Revealer of kaf-ha-ya-`ayn-sad and ta-ha, ya-sin,
and the Qur'an, full of wisdom.

lines.arabic: أَنْتَ كَهْفِي حِينَ تُعْيِينِي ٱلْمَذَاهِبُ فِي سَعَتِهَا
lines.transliteration: anta kahfi hina tu`yini almadhahibu fi sa`atiha
lines.english: You are my haven when the wide courses fail to carry me
and when the earth, despite its width, become too narrow to bear me.

lines.transliteration: wa lawla rahmatuka lakuntu min alhalikina
lines.english: Without Your mercy, I would have been of those perishing.
You overlook my slips;

lines.arabic: وَلَوْلاَ سَتْرُكَ إِيَّايَ لَكُنْتُ مِنَ ٱلْمَفْضُوحِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa lawla satruka iyyaya lakuntu min almafduhina
lines.english: and without Your covering me, I would have been of those exposed.
You aid me with Your support against my enemies;

lines.arabic: وَلَوْلاَ نَصْرُكَ إِيَّايَ لَكُنْتُ مِنَ ٱلْمَغْلُوبِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa lawla nasruka iyyaya lakuntu min almaghlubina
lines.english: and without Your support, I would have been of those overwhelmed.

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ خَصَّ نَفْسَهُ بِٱلسُّمُوِّ وَٱلرِّفْعَةِ
lines.transliteration: ya man khassa nafsahu bilssumuwwi walrrif`ati
lines.english: O He Who gives Himself exclusively superiority and highness;
so, His friends pride themselves on account of His pride.

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ جَعَلَتْ لَهُ ٱلْمُلُوكُ نِيرَ ٱلْمَذَلَّةِ عَلَىٰ أَعْنَاقِهِمْ
lines.transliteration: ya man ja`alat lahu almuluku nira almadhallati `ala a`naqihim
lines.english: O He for Whom the kings put the yoke of humiliation on their necks;
for they are fearful of His authority.

lines.arabic: يَعْلَمُ خَائِنَةَ ٱلأَعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِي ٱلصُّدُورُ
lines.transliteration: ya`lamu kha'inata al'a`yuni wa ma tukhfi alssuduru
lines.english: He knows the stealthy looks of eyes and that which the breasts conceal

lines.arabic: وَغَيْبَ مَا تَأْتِي بِهِ ٱلأَزْمِنَةُ وَٱلدُّهُورُ
lines.transliteration: wa ghayba ma ta'ti bihi al'azminatu waldduhuru
lines.english: and the future of the times and ages.

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ لاَ يَعْلَمُ كَيْفَ هُوَ إِلاَّ هُوَ
lines.transliteration: ya man la ya`lamu kayfa huwa illa huwa
lines.english: O He save Whom none knows how He is!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ لاَ يَعْلَمُ مَا هُوَ إِلاَّ هُوَ
lines.transliteration: ya man la ya`lamu ma huwa illa huwa
lines.english: O He save Whom none knows what He is!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ لاَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَعْلَمُهُ إِلاَّ هُوَ
lines.transliteration: ya man la ya`lamu ma ya`lamuhu illa huwa
lines.english: O He save Whom none knows what He knows!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ كَبَسَ ٱلأَرْضَ عَلَىٰ ٱلْمَاءِ
lines.english: O He Who surfaced the earth over the water
and blocked the air with the heavens!
O He Who has the noblest of names!

lines.arabic: يَا ذَا ٱلْمَعْرُوفِ ٱلَّذِي لاَ يَنْقَطِعُ أَبَداً
lines.transliteration: ya dhalma`rufi alladhi la yanqati`u abadan
lines.english: O Owner of favor that is never interrupted!

lines.arabic: يَا مُقَيِّضَ ٱلرَّكْبِ لِيُوسُفَ فِي ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْقَفْرِ
lines.transliteration: ya muqayyida alrrakbi liyusufa fi albaladi alqafri
lines.english: O He Who directed the caravan towards Joseph in the wasteland,
took him out of the pit,
and made him king after enslavement!
O He Who had returned him to Jacob

lines.arabic: بَعْدَ أَنِ ٱبْيَضَّتْ عَيْنَاهُ مِنَ ٱلْحُزْنِ فَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
lines.transliteration: ba`da an ibyaddat `aynahu min alhuzni fahuwa kazimun
lines.english: after his eyes became white on account of the grief, and he was a repressor of grief!

lines.arabic: يَا كَاشِفَ ٱلضُّرِّ وَٱلْبَلْوَىٰ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ
lines.english: O He Who removed the distress and misfortune from Job

lines.arabic: وَمُمْسِكَ يَدَيْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ ذَبْحِ ٱبْنِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa mumsika yaday ibrahima `an dhabhi ibnihi
lines.english: and withheld the hands of Abraham from slaying his son
after his old age and termination of his lifetime!
O He Who responded to Zachariah
and granted him John
without leaving him alone and lonely!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ أَخْرَجَ يُونُسَ مِنْ بَطْنِ ٱلْحُوتِ
lines.transliteration: ya man akhraja yunusa min batni alhuti
lines.english: O He Who took Jonah out of the belly of the big fish!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ فَلَقَ ٱلْبَحْرَ لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ
lines.transliteration: ya man falaqa albahra libani isra'ila
lines.english: O He Who cleft the sea to the children of Israel;

lines.arabic: فَأَنْجَاهُمْ وَجَعَلَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجُنُودَهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُغْرَقِينَ
lines.transliteration: fa'anjahum wa ja`ala fir`awna wa junudahu min almughraqina
lines.english: so, He saved them and made Pharaoh and his army of the drowned!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ أَرْسَلَ ٱلرِّيَاحَ مُبَشِّرَاتٍ بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهِ
lines.transliteration: ya man arsala alrriyaha mubashshiratin bayna yaday rahmatihi
lines.english: O He Who sent the winds, bearing good news, before His mercy!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ لَمْ يَعْجَلْ عَلَىٰ مَنْ عَصَاهُ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ
lines.transliteration: ya man lam ya`jal `ala man `asahu min khalqihi
lines.english: O He Who has no hastiness on His creatures who disobey Him!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنِ ٱسْتَنْقَذَ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ مِنْ بَعْدِ طُولِ ٱلْجُحُودِ
lines.transliteration: ya man istanqadha alssaharata min ba`di tuli aljuhudi
lines.english: O He Who saved the sorcerers after their long denial!
and after they had lived in His bounty,
eating from His sustenance, but serving someone else other than Him,
acting in opposition to Him, antagonizing Him,
and denying His messengers.

lines.arabic: يَا اللَّهُ يَا اللَّهُ يَا بَدِيءُ
lines.transliteration: ya allahu ya allahu ya badi'u
lines.english: O Allah! O Allah! O Originator!
O Fashioner! There is no equal to You.
O Everlasting! There is no end to You.
O Ever-living when there was no living thing!
O Raiser from the dead!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ هُوَ قَائِمٌ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ
lines.transliteration: ya man huwa qa'imun `ala kulli nafsin bima kasabat
lines.english: O He Who watches every soul as to what it earns!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ قَلَّ لَهُ شُكْرِي فَلَمْ يَحْرِمْنِي
lines.transliteration: ya man qalla lahu shukri falam yahrimni
lines.english: O He to Whom I rarely turned thankful; yet, He did not deprive me,
against Whom I committed grand sins; yet, He did not disclose me,
and Who saw me insisting on disobeying Him; yet, He did not divulge me.
O He Who safeguarded me in my early life!
O He Who provided me with sustenance in my old age!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ أَيَادِيهِ عِنْدِي لاَ تُحْصَىٰ
lines.english: O He Whose favors to me are innumerable
and Whose bounties cannot be compensated!
O He Who receives me with good turn and kindness
but I meet Him with offense and disobedience!
O He Who had guided me to faith

lines.arabic: مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ أَعْرِفَ شُكْرَ ٱلاِﹾمْتِنَانِ
lines.transliteration: min qabli an a`rifa shukra al'imtinani
lines.english: before I learnt showing gratitude!
O He Whom I besought in sickness; so, He restored me to health,
in bareness; so, He covered me,
in hunger; so, He satiated me,
in thirst; so, He quenched my thirst,
in humility; so, He granted me dignity,
in ignorance; so, He taught me,
in loneliness; so, He increased my number,
in foreignness absence; so, He returned me home,
in poverty; so, He enriched me,
in victory-seeking; so, He supported me,
and in richness; so, He did not deprive me.
When I withheld praying Him in all these situation, He took the initiative.
So, all praise and thanks be to You;
O He Who overlooked my slips,
relieved my agonies,
responded to my prayer,
covered my flaws,
forgave my sins,
settled my need,
and supported me against my enemy.

lines.transliteration: wa in a`udda ni`amaka wa minanaka
lines.english: If I count Your bounties, favors,
and liberal gifts, I will never number them.
O my Master! It is You Who bestowed (upon me).
It is You Who conferred favors (upon me).
It is You Who did good (to me).
It is You Who treated (me) excellently.
It is You Who favored (me).
It is You Who perfected (Your blessings upon me).
It is You Who provided (me) with sustenance.
It is You Who led (me) to success.
It is You Who gave (me).
It is You Who enriched (me).
It is You Who gave (me) to hold.
It is You Who gave (me) shelter.
It is You Who saved (me).
It is You Who guided (me).
It is You Who protected (me).
It is You Who covered my faults.
It is You Who forgave (me).
It is You Who overlooked my sins.
It is You Who established (me).
It is You Who consolidated (me).
It is You Who helped (me).
It is You Who backed (me) up.
It is You Who aided (me).
It is You Who supported (me).
It is You Who restored (me) to health.
It is You Who granted (me) wellbeing.
It is You Who honored (me).
Blessed be You and Exalted be You.
So, all praise be to You permanently,
and all thanks be to You enduringly and eternally.

lines.arabic: ثُمَّ أَنَا يَا إِلٰهِيَ ٱلْمُعْتَرِفُ بِذُنُوبِي
lines.transliteration: thumma ana ya ilhi almu`tarifu bidhunubi
lines.english: However, it is I, O my God, who confess of my sins;
so, (please) forgive them to me.
It is I who did badly.
It is I who did wrong.
It is I who had evil intention.
It is I who acted impolitely.
It is I who was inadvertent.
It is I who was inattentive.
It is I who leaned (on something other than You).
It is I who did wrong deliberately.
It is I who promised.
It is I who failed to fulfill it.
It is I who breached.
It is I who confessed.

lines.arabic: أَنَا ٱلَّذِي ٱعْتَرَفْتُ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَعِنْدِي
lines.english: It is I who testified to Your favors upon and with me,
and I now acknowledge of my sins; so, (please) forgive them to me.

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ لاَ تَضُرُّهُ ذُنُوبُ عِبَادِهِ
lines.english: O He Who is not injured by the sins of His servants,
and Who can surely do without their obedience,
and Who inspires those of them to do good,
out of His aid and mercy.
So, all praise be to You, O my God and my Master.
O my God: You ordered me, but I disobeyed You.
You warned me, but I violated Your warning.

lines.arabic: فَأَصْبَحْتُ لاَ ذَا بَرَاءَةٍ لِي فَأَعْتَذِرُ
lines.transliteration: fa'asbahtu la dha bara'atin li fa'a`tadhiru
lines.english: So, I am now lacking neither justification to apologize
nor power to support myself.
By which thing can I now meet You, O my Master?
Is it by my hearing, my sight,

lines.arabic: أَمْ بِلِسَانِي أَمْ بِيَدِي أَمْ بِرِجْلِي
lines.transliteration: am bilisani am biyadi am birijli
lines.english: my tongue, my hand, or my foot?
Are all these not Your bounties on me
and with all of them I have disobeyed You, O my Master?
You have absolute argument and claim against me.

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ سَتَرَنِي مِنَ ٱلآبَاءِ وَٱلأُمَّهَاتِ أَنْ يَزْجُرُونِي
lines.transliteration: ya man satarani min al'aba'i wal'ummahati an yazjuruni
lines.english: O He Who covered me from fathers and mothers lest they might have driven me away,

lines.transliteration: wa min al`asha'iri wal'ikhwani an yu`ayyiruni
lines.english: from relatives and friends lest they might have gibed me,
and from rulers lest they might have punished me.
Had they, O my Master, seen
that which You knew about me,
they would certainly have granted me no respite
and they would have rejected and parted company with me.
Here I am now, O my God,
between Your hands, O my Master,
submissive, humble,
helpless, and worthless.
I am now lacking neither justification to apologize
nor power to support myself,
nor excuse to advance as a plea,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ قَائِلٌ لَمْ أَجْتَرِحْ وَلَمْ أَعْمَلْ سُوءاً
lines.transliteration: wa la qa'ilun lam ajtarih wa lam a`mal su'an
lines.english: nor can I claim not committing and not acting badly.

lines.arabic: وَمَا عَسَىٰ ٱلْجُحُودُ وَلَوْ جَحَدْتُ يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَنْفَعُنِي
lines.transliteration: wa ma `asa aljuhudu wa law jahadtu ya mawlaya yanfa`uni
lines.english: How can denial, if I deny, O my Master, serve me?
How and in what manner can I do so,

lines.arabic: وَجَوَارِحِي كُلُّهَا شَاهِدَةٌ عَلَيَّ بِمَا قَدْ عَمِلْتُ
lines.transliteration: wa jawarihi kulliha shahidatun `alayya bima qad `amiltu
lines.english: while all my organs are witnesses for what I did?
I know for sure and without doubt
that You will interrogate me about these grand matter,

lines.arabic: وَأَنَّكَ ٱلْحَكَمُ ٱلْعَدْلُ الَّذِي لاَ تَجُورُ
lines.transliteration: wa annaka alhakamu al`adlu alladhi la tajuru
lines.english: You are the Just Judge Who never wrongs,
Your justice will ruin me,
and from Your all justice I flee.
If You, O my God, chastise me,
then it is because of my sins after Your claim against me;
and if You pardon me,
then it is on account of Your forbearance, magnanimity, and generosity.
There is no god save You. All glory be to You.
I have been of the wrongdoers.
There is no god save You. All glory be to You.
I have been of those seeking forgiveness.
There is no god save You. All glory be to You.
I have been of those professing Your Oneness.
There is no god save You. All glory be to You.
I have been of the fearful.
There is no god save You. All glory be to You.
I have been of the apprehensive.
There is no god save You. All glory be to You.
I have been of those hoping (for You).
There is no god save You. All glory be to You.
I have been of those desiring (for You).
There is no god save You. All glory be to You.
I have been of those professing that there is no god save You.
There is no god save You. All glory be to You.
I have been of those beseeching (You).
There is no god save You. All glory be to You.
I have been of those glorifying (You).
There is no god save You. All glory be to You.
I have been of those professing that You are the Greatest.
There is no god save You. All glory be to You.
You are my Lord and the Lord of my bygone fathers.
O Allah, this is my praise for You, celebrating Your glory,
my sincerity to mention You and profess Your Oneness,
and my acknowledgment of Your bounties, counting them,

lines.arabic: وَإِنْ كُنْتُ مُقِرّاً أَنِّي لَمْ أُحْصِهَا
lines.transliteration: wa in kuntu muqirran anni lam uhsiha
lines.english: although I confess that I could never count them
for they are innumerable, abundant,

lines.transliteration: wa tazahuriha wa taqadumiha ila hadithin ma
lines.english: continuous, and prior to a certain event.
You have been conferring upon me with these bounties
since You created and originated me
from the beginning of my age
through meeting my poverty
relieving me from harm,
giving me means of easiness,
repelling misery from me,
alleviating my agonies,
granting me wellbeing in my body,
and furnishing me with sound faith.

lines.arabic: وَلَوْ رَفَدَنِي عَلَىٰ قَدْرِ ذِكْرِ نِعْمَتِكَ جَمِيعُ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa law rafadani `ala qadri dhikri ni`matika jami`u al`alamina
lines.english: If all creatures assist me to be able to mention Your bounties,
including the past and the coming generations,

lines.arabic: مَا قَدَرْتُ وَلاَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ ذٰلِكَ
lines.transliteration: ma qadartu wa la hum `ala dhalika
lines.english: neither I nor will they be able to do that.
Holy be You and Exalted be You;
You are All-generous, All-great, and All-merciful Sustainer.
Your bounties are innumerable,
(proper) praise of You is unreachable,
and Your graces cannot be rewarded.
(Please) send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
perfect Your bounties for us,
and make us happy by obeying You.
All glory be to You. There is no god save You.
O Allah, verily, You answer the distressed,
remove the evil,
aid the anguished,
cure the ailed,
enrich the poor,
set the broken,
have mercy on the young,
help the old,
none can help against You,
none is more powerful than You,
and You are the Most High, the All-great.
O He Who release the shackled captive!
O He Who provides sustenance to the young child!
O He Who is the Preserver of the afraid seeker of refuge!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَلاَ وَزِيرَ
lines.transliteration: ya man la sharika lahu wa la wazira
lines.english: O He Who has neither partner nor assistant,
(please) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
and grant me, in this evening,
the best of what You have granted and awarded
to any of Your servants,
including a grace that You donate,
bounties that You re-offer,
a tribulation that You deter,
an anguish that You remove,
a prayer that You answer,
a good deed that You admit,
and an evildoing that You screen.
Verily, You are All-tender to him You will, and All-aware,
and You have power over all things.
O Allah, Verily, You are the nearest of those whom are prayed,
You are the promptest of those who may respond,
the most generous of those who may pardon,
the most liberal of those who give,
and the most responding of those whom are asked.

lines.transliteration: ya rahmana alddunya wal-akhirati wa rahimahuma
lines.english: O All-beneficent of the world and the Hereafter, and All-merciful!
No besought one is like You
and none save You is hoped.
I prayed You and You answered me.
I besought You and You gave me.
I desired for You and You had mercy on me.
I had confidence in You and You saved me.
I resorted to You in awe and You delivered me.
O Allah, (please) send blessings to Muhammad,
Your servant, messenger, and prophet,
and to all of his Household, the pure and immaculate,
and perfect for us Your graces,
make us taste the pleasure of Your gifts,
and register us as thankful for You
and as oft-referring to You.
Respond, respond! O Lord of the worlds!
O Allah, Who owns; therefore, He controls,
and controls; therefore, He has absolute authority,
and is disobeyed; yet, He covers,
and is prayed for forgiveness; therefore, He forgives.
O He Who is the aim of seekers and desirers
and the ultimate purpose of the hope of hopers!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ أَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيْء عِلْماً
lines.english: O He Who encompasses all things in knowledge

lines.transliteration: wa wasi`a almustaqilina ra'fatan wa rahmatan wa hilman
lines.english: and covers those who quit (their sins) with tender, mercy, and forbearance!

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْكَ فِي هٰذِهِ ٱلْعَشِيَّةِ
lines.transliteration: allahumma inna natawajjahu ilayka fi hadhihi al`ashiyyati
lines.english: O Allah, we turn our faces to You in this evening
that You deem honorable and reverential
(asking You) in the name of Muhammad, Your Prophet, Messenger,
the best of Your creation,
Your trustee on Your Revelation,
the bearer of glad tidings, the warner,
and the shining lantern,
with whom You have conferred upon the Muslims,
and whom You made mercy for the worlds.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
lines.transliteration: allahumma fasalli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
lines.english: So, O Allah, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

lines.arabic: كَمَا مُحَمَّدٌ أَهْلٌ لِذٰلِكَ مِنْكَ يَا عَظِيمُ
lines.transliteration: kama muhammadun ahlun lidhalika minka ya `azimu
lines.english: forasmuch as Muhammad deserves that from You, O All-great.
So, (please) send blessings to him and his Household,
the elite, pure, and immaculate—all of them,
and encompass us with Your pardoning us.
To You are the voices of various languages clamoring;

lines.arabic: فَٱجْعَلْ لَنَا ٱللَّهُمَّ فِي هٰذِهِ ٱلْعَشِيَّةِ
lines.transliteration: faj`al lana allahumma fi hadhihi al`ashiyyati
lines.english: so, decide for us, O Allah, in this evening

lines.arabic: نَصِيباً مِنْ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ تَقْسِمُهُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ
lines.transliteration: nasiban min kulli khayrin taqsimuhu bayna `ibadika
lines.english: a share from every good item that You distribute among Your servants,
illumination by which You guide,
mercy that You spread,
blessing that You bring down,
wellbeing that You extend,
and sustenance that You stretch,
O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
O Allah, turn us in this hour
successful, flourishing,
blessed, and gainers.
Do not include us with the despondent.
Do not leave us without Your mercy.

lines.arabic: وَلاَ تَحْرِمْنَا مَا نُؤَمِّلُهُ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa la tahrimna ma nu'ammiluhu min fadlika
lines.english: Do not deprive us of that which we hope from Your favor.

lines.transliteration: wa la taj`alna min rahmatika mahrumina
lines.english: Do not make us deprived of Your mercy,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ لِفَضْلِ مَا نُؤَمِّلُهُ مِنْ عَطَائِكَ قَانِطِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa la lifadli ma nu'ammiluhu min `ata'ika qanitina
lines.english: or despair of the favor of what we hope from Your gifts.
Do not turns us down disappointed
or driven away from Your door.
O most Magnanimous of all those who treat magnanimously
and most Generous of all those who act generously!
To You are we advancing with full conviction
and to Your Holy House are we betaking ourselves purposefully;
So, (please) help us do our rituals (perfectly)
perfect for us our pilgrimage
pardon us, and grant us wellbeing.
We are stretching our hands toward You;
so, they are marked by the humiliation of confession.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَأَعْطِنَا فِي هٰذِهِ ٱلْعَشِيَّةِ مَا سَأَلْنَاكَ
lines.transliteration: allahumma fa'a`tina fi hadhihi al`ashiyyati ma sa'alnaka
lines.english: O Allah, grant us in this evening that which we have besought from You
and save us from that which we have besought You to save us;
for we have no savior but You
and we have no sustainer but You.
Your decree is prevalent on us,
Your knowledge is encompassing us,
and Your decisions about us is just.
(Please) decree for us that which is good
and make us of the people of goodness.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَوْجِبْ لَنَا بِجُودِكَ عَظِيمَ ٱلأَجْرِ
lines.english: O Allah, decide for us, on account of Your magnanimity, a great reward,
a generous reserve,
and a permanent easiness,
and forgive us all our sins,
do not annihilate us with those annihilated,

lines.transliteration: wa la tasrif `anna ra'fataka wa rahmataka
lines.english: and do not drive away from us Your tenderness and mercy;
O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ٱجْعَلْنَا فِي هٰذَا ٱلْوَقْتِ مِمَّنْ سَأَلَكَ فَأَعْطَيْتَهُ
lines.transliteration: allahumma ij`alna fi hadha alwaqti mimman sa'alaka fa'a`taytahu
lines.english: O Allah, include us, at this hour, with them who besought You and You thus gave them,
who thanked You and You thus increased them,
who returned to You and You thus accepted them,

lines.arabic: وَتَنَصَّلَ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِهِ كُلِّهَا فَغَفَرْتَهَا لَهُ
lines.transliteration: wa tanassala ilayka min dhunubihi kulliha faghafartaha lahu
lines.english: and who renounced all their sins before You and You thus forgave them;
O Lord of Majesty and Honor!
O Allah, purify us and lead us to success
and admit our earnest entreaty;
O He Who is the best of all those who are besought
and most Merciful of all those whose mercy is sought!

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ لاَ يَخْفَىٰ عَلَيْهِ إِغْمَاضُ ٱلْجُفُونِ
lines.transliteration: ya man la yakhfa `alayhi ighmadu aljufuni
lines.english: O He from Whom the closing of eyelids cannot be hidden,
nor are the glances of eyes,

lines.transliteration: wa la ma istaqarra fi almaknuni
lines.english: nor is that which settles in the unseen,

lines.arabic: وَلاَ مَا ٱنْطَوَتْ عَلَيْهِ مُضْمَرَاتُ ٱلْقُلُوبِ
lines.transliteration: wa la ma intawat `alayhi mudmaratu alqulubi
lines.english: nor are things vanished under the secrets of hearts.

lines.arabic: أَلاَ كُلُّ ذٰلِكَ قَدْ أَحْصَاهُ عِلْمُكَ
lines.english: Verily, all that has been encompassed by Your knowledge
and covered by Your forbearance.
All glory be to You; and Exalted be You above all that the wrongdoers say,
in high exaltation!
Declaring You glory are the seven heavens,
the (layers of the) earth, and all beings therein.

lines.arabic: وَإِنْ مِنْ شَيْء إِلاَّ يُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa in min shay'in illa yusabbihu bihamdika
lines.english: There is not a thing but celebrates Your praise.
Yours are all praise, glory,
and exaltation of majesty.
O Owner of majesty, honor,
grace, favoring,
and huge bestowals.
You are the All-magnanimous, the All-generous,
the All-tender, the All-merciful.

lines.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَوْسِعْ عَلَيَّ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ ٱلْحَلاَلِ
lines.english: O Allah, provide me largely with Your legally gotten sustenance,
grant me wellbeing in my body and my faith,
secure my fears,
and release me from Hellfire.
O Allah, (please) do not plan against me,
do not draw me near to destruction,
do not overreach me,

lines.arabic: وَٱدْرَأْ عَنِّي شَرَّ فَسَقَةِ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلإِنْسِ
lines.english: and drive away from me the evils of the corruptive Jinn and men.
O most Hearing of all those who can hear!
O most Seeing of all those who can see!
O swiftest of all those who call to account!
O most Merciful of all those who show mercy!
(Please) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
the auspicious chiefs;
and I beseech You for my request

lines.arabic: ٱلَّتِي إِنْ أَعْطَيْتَنِيهَا لَمْ يَضُرَّنِي مَا مَنَعْتَنِي
lines.transliteration: allati in a`taytaniha lam yadurrani ma mana`tani
lines.english: that if You answer, anything else that You reject will not harm me

lines.arabic: وَإِنْ مَنَعْتَنِيهَا لَمْ يَنْفَعْنِي مَا أَعْطَيْتَنِي
lines.transliteration: wa in mana`taniha lam yanfa`ni ma a`taytani
lines.english: and if You reject, anything else that You respond will not benefit me.
I beseech You for releasing me from Hellfire.
There is no god save You,
only You, there is no partner with You.
To You is the kingdom and to You is all praise,
and You have power over all things.

lines.arabic: يَا رَبِّ يَا رَبّ يَا رَبّ…
lines.transliteration: ya rabbi ya rabbi ya rabbi…
lines.english: O my Lord! O my Lord! O my Lord…
O my God, I am needy despite my richness;

lines.arabic: فَكَيْفَ لا أَكُونُ فَقِيراً فِي فَقْرِي؟
lines.transliteration: fakayfa la akunu faqiran fi faqri
lines.english: so, how can I not be needy in my neediness?
O my God, I am ignorant despite my knowledge;

lines.arabic: فَكَيْفَ لاَ أَكُونُ جَهُولاً فِي جَهْلِي؟
lines.transliteration: fakayfa la akunu jahulan fi jahli
lines.english: so, how can I not be ignorant in my ignorance?
O my God, the variety of Your regulating of matters
and the swiftness of changes in Your ordainments
have urged Your servants, who recognize You,
not to stop at a certain gift
and not to despair of You in tribulations.
O my God, coming out of me is that which fits my lowliness;
but coming from You is that which befits Your nobleness.

lines.arabic: إِلٰهِي وَصَفْتَ نَفْسَكَ بِٱللُّطْفِ وَٱلرَّأْفَةِ لِي
lines.transliteration: ilahi wasafta nafsaka billutfi walrra'fati li
lines.english: O my God, You had ascribed to Yourself gentleness and kindness to me
before the existence of my weakness.
Will You deprive me of these two after the emergence of my weakness?
O my God, if amenities appear in my conduct,
then that is on account of Your favors and Your conferral on me.
If evildoings appear in my conduct,
then that is still Your justice and You have claim against me.

lines.arabic: إِلٰهِي كَيْفَ تَكِلُنِي وَقَدْ تَكَفَّلْتَ لِي؟
lines.transliteration: ilahi kayfa takiluni wa qad takaffalta li
lines.english: O my God, how may it be that You abandon me after You have vouched for me?

lines.transliteration: wa kayfa udamu wa anta alnnasiru li
lines.english: How may I be aggrieved and You are my support?

lines.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ أَخِيبُ وَأَنْتَ ٱلْحَفِيُّ بِي؟
lines.transliteration: am kayfa akhibu wa anta alhafiyyu bi
lines.english: How may I be disappointed and You are undertaking my affairs?

lines.arabic: هَا أَنَا أَتَوَسَّلُ إِلَيْكَ بِفَقْرِي إِلَيْكَ
lines.transliteration: ha ana atawassalu ilayka bifaqri ilayka
lines.english: Here I am begging You by my need for You.
How can I beg You

lines.arabic: بِمَا هُوَ مَحَالٌ أَنْ يَصِلَ إِلَيْكَ؟
lines.transliteration: bima huwa mahalun an yasila ilayka
lines.english: by something that is impossible to reach You?
How can I complain to You about my manners
while they cannot be hidden from You?
How can I interpret my words
while You are their source?
How come that You may let down my hopes,
while they are addressed to You?
How come that You may not improve my conditions
while they are originated by You?
O my God, how gentle You are to me
despite my notorious ignorance!
How merciful You are to me
despite my hideous deeds!
O my God, how nigh to me You are
and how far from You I am!
How kind to me You are;
so, what is that which can prevent me from You?
O my God, I have known, through variety of signs
and changes of phases,

lines.arabic: أَنَّ مُرَادَكَ مِنِّي أَنْ تَتَعَرَّفَ إِلَيَّ فِي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
lines.transliteration: anna muradaka minni an tata`arrafa ilayya fi kulli shay'in
lines.english: that what You want from me is that You introduce Yourself to me in all things
so that I will not ignore You in any thing.
O my God, whenever my lowliness suppresses my voice,
Your nobility encourages me to speak.
Whenever my features lead me to despair (of You),
Your bestowals make me crave for You.
O my God, as for he whose good deeds are wrongdoings;
how can his wrongdoings not be wrongdoings?
As for he whose facts are mere claims,
how can his claims not be claims?

lines.transliteration: ilahi hukmuka alnnafidhu wa mashi'atuka alqahiratu
lines.english: O my God, Your unstoppable decree and Your surmounting volition
have not left any word to be said by any orator
and have not left any manner to be displayed.
O my God, too many are the acts of obedience that I have prepared
and the conducts that I have established,
but Your justice has ruined my reliance on these,
and, moreover, Your favoring has made me abandon them.
O my God, You surely know

lines.arabic: أَنِّي وَإِنْ لَمْ تَدُمِ ٱلطَّاعَةُ مِنِّي فِعْلاً جَزْماً
lines.transliteration: anni wa in lam tadum altta`atu minni fi`lan jazman
lines.english: that even my obedience (to You) has not lasted in reality,
it has lasted in love (for it) and determination (to do it)!

lines.transliteration: ilahi kayfa a`zimu wa anta alqahiru
lines.english: O my God, how can I determine, while You are All-supreme?

lines.transliteration: wa kayfa la a`zimu wa anta al'amiru
lines.english: How can I quit determining, while it is Your command (to determine)?
O my God, my hesitation in (following) Your traces
will result in unlikely visitation;
so, (please) join me to You through a service that takes me to You.

lines.arabic: كَيْفَ يُسْتَدَلُّ عَلَيْكَ بِمَا هُوَ فِي وُجُودِهِ مُفْتَقِرٌ إِلَيْكَ؟
lines.transliteration: kayfa yustadallu `alayka bima huwa fi wujudihi muftaqirun ilayka
lines.english: How can You be figured out through that whose existence relies on You?

lines.arabic: أَيَكُونُ لِغَيْرِكَ مِنَ ٱلظُّهُورِ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ
lines.transliteration: ayakunu lighayrika min alzzuhuri ma laysa laka
lines.english: Can any thing other than You hold a (kind of) manifestation that You lack
and thus it may act as an appearance for You?

lines.arabic: مَتَىٰ غِبْتَ حَتَّىٰ تَحْتَاجَ إِلَىٰ دَلِيلٍ يَدُلُّ عَلَيْكَ؟
lines.transliteration: mata ghibta hatta tahtaja ila dalilin yadullu `alayka
lines.english: When have You ever been absent so that You may need something to point to You?

lines.arabic: وَمَتَىٰ بَعُدْتَ حَتَّىٰ تَكُونَ ٱلآثَارُ هِيَ ٱلَّتِي تُوصِلُ إِلَيْكَ؟
lines.transliteration: wa mata ba`udta hatta takuna al'atharu hiya allati tusilu ilayka
lines.english: When have You ever been far-off so that traces may lead to You?

lines.arabic: عَمِيَتْ عَيْنٌ لاَ تَرَاكَ عَلَيْهَا رَقِيباً
lines.english: Blind be the eye that cannot see You watching it.

lines.arabic: وَخَسِرَتْ صَفْقَةُ عَبْدٍ لَمْ تَجْعَلْ لَهُ مِنْ حُبِّكَ نَصِيباً
lines.transliteration: wa khasirat safqatu `abdin lam taj`al lahu min hubbika nasiban
lines.english: Losing is a servant’s deal that does not dedicate a share to the love for You.
O my God, You have ordered us to refer to the traces;
therefore, (please do) make me refer to You with the garb of lights
and the guidance of insight

lines.arabic: حَتَّىٰ أَرْجِعَ إِلَيْكَ مِنْهَا كَمَا دَخَلْتُ إِلَيْكَ مِنْهَا
lines.transliteration: hatta arji`a ilayka minha kama dakhaltu ilayka minha
lines.english: so that I will return to You in the same way as I have entered to You from them
as being too protected to look at them
and too determining to depend upon them,
for You have power over all things.

lines.arabic: إِلٰهِي هٰذَا ذُلِّي ظَاهِرٌ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ
lines.transliteration: ilahi hadha dhulli zahirun bayna yadayka
lines.english: O my God, this is my humiliation; it manifests itself before You.
This is my manner; it cannot be concealed against You.
From You do I beseech soaring to You
and through You do I take the way to You.
So, (please do) guide me to You through Your Light

lines.transliteration: wa aqimni bisidqi al`ubudiyyati bayna yadayka
lines.english: and make me stand up before Your Hands with the true servitude to You.
O my God, (please do) teach me from Your veiled knowledge
and protect me with Your shielding shelter.
O my God, (please do) grant me the realities that are enjoyed by the people who are near to You
and make me follow the course of the people who are attracted to You.

lines.arabic: إِلٰهِي أَغْنِنِي بِتَدْبِيرِكَ لِي عَنْ تَدْبِيرِي
lines.english: O my God, make Your management of my affairs replace my management of my affairs,
make Your choice for me replace my choice for myself,
and make me stop at the points of emergency.
My God, deliver me from the humiliation of my soul.

lines.transliteration: wa tahhirni min shakki wa shirki
lines.english: and purify me from my suspicion and polytheism
before I enter my grave.
Only through You do I achieve victory; so, (please do) give me victory.
Only upon You do I rely; so, do not refer me to anyone else.
Only You do I beseech; so, do not disappoint me.

lines.transliteration: wa fi fadlika arghabu fala tahrimni
lines.english: Only for Your favors do I desire; so, do not deprive me (of Your favors).
Only to Your side do I resort; so, do not set me aside.
At Your door only do I stand; so, do not drive me away.

lines.arabic: إِلٰهِي تَقَدَّسَ رِضَاكَ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ عِلَّةٌ مِنْكَ
lines.transliteration: ilahi taqaddasa ridaka an yakuna lahu `illatun minka
lines.english: O my God, Your pleasure is too sanctified to receive a defect from You;
hence, how can it receive a defect from me?

lines.arabic: إِلٰهِي أَنْتَ ٱلْغَنِيُّ بِذَاتِكَ أَنْ يَصِلَ إِلَيْكَ ٱلنَّفْعُ مِنْكَ
lines.transliteration: ilahi anta alghaniyyu bidhatika an yasila ilayka alnnaf`u minka
lines.english: O my God, You are too self-sufficient by Yourself to be benefited by Yourself;
hence, how can You not be self-sufficient from me?
O my God, fate awakens my hope

lines.transliteration: wa inna alhawa biwatha'iqi alshshahwati asarani
lines.english: and whim has enchained me with the firm chains of lust;
so, (please do) be my Supporter
so that You shall back me and show me the right path.
And (please do) help me (to dispense with anyone else) through Your favors
so that I shall depend upon You exclusively in my requests.

lines.arabic: أَنْتَ ٱلَّذِي أَشْرَقْتَ ٱلأَنْوَارَ فِي قُلُوبِ أَوْلِيَائِكَ
lines.transliteration: anta alladhi ashraqta al'anwara fi qulubi awliya'ika
lines.english: It is You Who have lit the illuminations in the hearts of Your intimate servants
so that they have recognized and testified Your Oneness.

lines.arabic: وَأَنْتَ ٱلَّذِي أَزَلْتَ ٱلأَغْيَارَ عَنْ قُلُوبِ أَحِبَّائِكَ
lines.transliteration: wa anta alladhi azalta al'aghyara `an qulubi ahibba'ika
lines.english: It is You Who have removed love for others from the hearts of Your lovers
so that they have loved none save You
and they have resorted to none save You.
You alone are entertaining them
when they have felt lonely because of the other worlds.
You alone have guided them
so that all other worlds manifested themselves before them.
What can one who misses You find any substitute?

lines.transliteration: wa ma alladhi faqada man wajadaka
lines.english: What can one who finds You miss anything else?

lines.arabic: لَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ رَضِيَ دُونَكَ بَدَلاً
lines.transliteration: laqad khaba man radiya dunaka badalan
lines.english: Definitely, failing is he who has accepted anyone other than You as substitute.

lines.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَسِرَ مَنْ بَغَىٰ عَنْكَ مُتَحَوِّلاً
lines.transliteration: wa laqad khasira man bagha `anka mutahawwilan
lines.english: Definitely, loser is he who have desired for anyone other than You.
How can anyone other than You be hoped
whilst You have never stopped Your bounties?
How can anyone other than You be besought
whilst You have never changed Your habit of ceaseless bestowal?

lines.arabic: يَا مَنْ أَذَاقَ أَحِبَّاءَهُ حَلاَوَةَ ٱلْمُؤَانَسَةِ
lines.transliteration: ya man adhaqa ahibba'ahu halawata almu'anasati
lines.english: O He Who has made His lovers the sweet taste of entertainment;
therefore, they have stood up before Him flattering Him!

lines.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ أَلْبَسَ أَوْلِيَاءَهُ مَلاَبِسَ هَيْبَتِهِ
lines.transliteration: wa ya man albasa awliya'ahu malabisa haybatihi
lines.english: O He Who has dressed His intimate servants the garments of fearing Him;
therefore, they have stood before Him seeking His forgiveness!
You do mention the others (with bounties) before they mention You.

lines.arabic: وَأَنْتَ ٱلْبَادِئُ بِٱلإِحْسَانِ قَبْلَ تَوَجُّهِ ٱلْعَابِدِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa anta albadi'u bil'ihsani qabla tawajjuhi al`abidina
lines.english: You do spread Your compassion before the worshippers direct towards You.

lines.arabic: وَأَنْتَ ٱلْجَوَادُ بِٱلْعَطَاءِ قَبْلَ طَلَبِ ٱلطَّالِبِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa anta aljawadu bil`ata'i qabla talabi alttalibina
lines.english: You do give generously before You are asked.

lines.arabic: وَأَنْتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ ثُمَّ لِمَا وَهَبْتَ لَنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُسْتَقْرِضِينَ
lines.transliteration: wa anta alwahhabu thumma lima wahabta lana min almustaqridina
lines.english: You do bestow upon us and then borrow from us that which You have bestowed upon us.

lines.arabic: إِلٰهِي ٱطْلُبْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ حَتَّىٰ أَصِلَ إِلَيْكَ
lines.transliteration: ilahi utlubni birahmatika hatta asila ilayka
lines.english: O my God, (please do) refer to me with Your mercy so that I will appear before You.
(Please do) draw me towards You through Your endless favoring so that I will advance to You.

lines.arabic: إِلٰهِي إِنَّ رَجَائِي لاَ يَنْقَطِعُ عَنْكَ وَإِنْ عَصَيْتُكَ
lines.transliteration: ilahi inna raja'i la yanqati`u `anka wa in `asaytuka
lines.english: O my God, verily, my hope for You does not cease despite that I may disobey You.

lines.arabic: كَمَا أَنَّ خَوفِي لاَ يُزَايِلُنِي وَإِنْ أَطَعْتُكَ
lines.transliteration: kama anna khawfi la yuzayiluni wa in ata`tuka
lines.english: Similarly, my fear from You does not leave me even if I obey You.
The Worlds have pushed me towards You
and my acquaintance with Your magnanimity has led me to You.

lines.transliteration: ilahi kayfa akhibu wa anta amali
lines.english: O my God, how can I fail whilst You are my hope?
How can I be humiliated whilst I depend upon You?

lines.arabic: إِلٰهِي كَيْفَ أَسْتَعِزُّ وَفِي ٱلذِّلَّةِ أَرْكَزْتَنِي؟
lines.transliteration: ilahi kayfa asta`izzu wa fi aldhdhillati arkaztani
lines.english: How can see dignity if You fix me in humiliation?

lines.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ لاَ أَسْتَعِزُّ وَإِلَيْكَ نَسَبْتَنِي؟
lines.transliteration: am kayfa la asta`izzu wa ilayka nasabtani
lines.english: How can I not see dignity whilst You have referred me to You?

lines.arabic: إِلٰهِي كَيْفَ لاَ أَفْتَقِرُ وَأَنْتَ ٱلَّذِي فِي ٱلْفُقَرَاءِ أَقَمْتَنِي؟
lines.transliteration: ilahi kayfa la aftaqiru wa anta alladhi fi alfuqara'i aqamtani
lines.english: O my God, how can I not be needy whilst it is You Who have lodged me among the needy?

lines.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ أَفْتَقِرُ وَأَنْتَ ٱلَّذِي بِجُودِكَ أَغْنَيْتَنِي؟
lines.transliteration: am kayfa aftaqiru wa anta alladhi bijudika aghnaytani
lines.english: How can I be needy whilst You have made me rich out of Your magnanimity?

lines.transliteration: wa anta alladhi la ilaha ghayruka
lines.english: It is You, there is no god save You,

lines.arabic: تَعَرَّفْتَ لِكُلِّ شَيْء فَمَا جَهِلَكَ شَيْءٌ
lines.transliteration: ta`arrafta likulli shay'in fama jahilaka shay'un
lines.english: Who have introduced Yourself to all things; therefore, nothing has ever ignored You.

lines.arabic: وَأَنْتَ ٱلَّذِي تَعَرَّفْتَ إِلَيَّ فِي كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
lines.transliteration: wa anta alladhi ta`arrafta ilayya fi kulli shay'in
lines.english: It is You Who have introduced Yourself to me in all things;
therefore, I have seen You Manifest in all things.
It is You Who give manifestation to all things.
O He Who is firm in power through His All-beneficence;
therefore, the Throne has become unseen in His Essence.
You have erased the traces by the traces;

lines.transliteration: wa mahawta al'aghyara bimuhitati aflaki al'anwari
lines.english: and You have erased the changeable by the surroundings of the orbits of lights.

lines.arabic: يَا مَنِ ٱحْتَجَبَ فِي سُرَادِقَاتِ عَرْشِهِ
lines.english: O He Who has screened Himself in the curtains of His Throne;
hence, He cannot be comprehended by visions!
O He Who has manifested Himself with His perfect Magnificence;
therefore, His Grandeur of being firm in power.
How can You be hidden whilst You are the Manifester (of all things)?

lines.arabic: أَمْ كَيْفَ تَغِيبُ وَأَنْتَ ٱلرَّقِيبُ ٱلْحَاضِرُ؟
lines.transliteration: am kayfa taghibu wa anta alrraqibu alhadiru
lines.english: Or how can You be absent whilst You are the Watcher (over all things) and the Present (at all times).
Verily, You have power over all things.
All praise be to Allah alone.
